zh-CN.title: 小红书爆款种草图文批量照抄 By 灵途 AI
zh-CN.description: 参考小红书图文的内容结构与视觉方式，用自有素材重新创作成套种草图文与发布文案。
zh-CN.prompt: 参考这篇小红书图文笔记的结构和视觉方式，用我提供的素材重新创作一套种草图文，并输出可以直接交给素人发布的图片和发布计划。
highlights: 拆解公开小红书图文笔记的内容结构、页序节奏和视觉语法
结合素材文件夹、指定图片和品牌素材逐页重新创作
输出按日期、系列和编号命名的 JPG 成品包与发布计划
zh-CN.input: 一篇公开的小红书图文笔记链接，以及素材文件夹或若干指定图片；可选主题、受众、系列名和输出目录。
zh-CN.output: 每套独立目录中的按页序 JPG 图片和发布计划.md，内部素材分析与生成档案单独保存。
zh-CN.requirement: 图片生成需要配置 LINGTU_API_KEY。只支持小红书图文笔记，不处理视频笔记、自动发布或原作逐字复制。

en-US.title: Xiaohongshu Photo-Post Remake by LINGTU AI
en-US.description: Recreate a Xiaohongshu photo post with your own assets while following the reference structure and visual language.
en-US.prompt: Use this public Xiaohongshu photo post as a structural and visual reference, remake it with my assets, and deliver images plus a posting plan that I can hand directly to a creator.
highlights: Break down the content roles, page sequence, pacing, and visual grammar of a public photo post
Recreate every page with selected images, material folders, and reusable brand assets
Deliver JPG packages named by date, series, and sequence together with a posting plan
en-US.input: One public Xiaohongshu photo-post URL plus a material folder or selected images, with optional topic, audience, series name, and output directory.
en-US.output: One delivery folder per set containing ordered JPG images and 发布计划.md, with generation work files stored separately.
en-US.requirement: Image generation requires LINGTU_API_KEY. Photo posts only; video notes, automatic publishing, and verbatim copying are not supported.
